title: Why Karna's Chariot Wheel Got Stuck in the Mud
description: At the decisive moment of the Kurukshetra war, the invincible warrior Karna was brought down not by lack of skill, but by the weight of a forgotten curse. Discover how a tragic past mistake caused his chariot wheel to sink into the earth, sealing his fate against Arjuna. This is the story of how karma finally caught up with one of the greatest heroes of the Mahabharata.
